title: refactor: preserve text request inputs
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Preserves empty and whitespace-only user content instead of injecting a synthetic prompt.
- Forwards numeric generation options unchanged instead of clamping or rounding them silently.
- Keeps OpenAI-compatible POST validation at the request boundary; legacy simple-text inputs are accepted or rejected by the selected provider.
- Removes 32 net lines.
- Passes 22 focused tests, Gen typecheck, Biome, and diff checks.

gist.headline: No more imaginary prompts
gist.blurb: The text gateway has stopped helpfully inventing words on your behalf. Empty space remains empty space, and generation settings arrive exactly as sent.
gist.summary: Text request normalization now preserves empty and whitespace-only content, forwards numeric generation options without silent clamping or rounding, and leaves legacy simple-text validation to the selected provider while retaining OpenAI-compatible POST validation at the gateway boundary.
gist.impact: Developers can send intentional blank content and precise numeric settings through the text API, with providers receiving the original request values instead of rewritten substitutes.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy retro text terminal where an intentionally blank message card and several precisely labeled number dials travel untouched along a garden-like API conveyor. Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses, carefully preserves the blank card while a code-plant grows beside the terminal, representing inputs reaching the selected provider unchanged.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-dark-brown striped bee mascot with black oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a happy smile, light blue rounded wings, and tiny librarian glasses, carefully carrying a blank message card past a retro terminal with unaltered numeric dials; lime green (#ecf874) code-plants and small flowers grow around the request path. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, with subtle pixel-font text on the terminal: "AS SENT".
